runs.name: p3-nose-on
runs.description: nose on: 60 scattered cells, chemo gene 1.5, a vent spring in the middle, crawling free

evals.js: const v=moire.cells.view; moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW*0.5, v.cssH*0.5, 'heavy', 1e9, {rate: 40}); moire.eat.params.pay=false; return 'spring'

return JSON.stringify({senses: moire.senses.census && {nose: moire.senses.census.nose}, flow: moire.flow.census && {enrich: moire.flow.census.enrich, near: moire.flow.census.nearSpring, align: moire.flow.census.alignPath, smellRel: moire.flow.census.smellRel}})
